newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady, fuel oil gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, fuel oil gains.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly steady on Friday, with fuel oil stronger, traders said.
Gas oil rose $8.50. Cargo premiums were stable with heating oil at Jan IPE +$4.50 and low sulphur diesel at +$13.50/15.
Naphtha was steady. Bids were pegged around Jan swaps levels at $215-$216 a tonne cif NWE.
Gasoline was steady to firmer. Most prompt cargo avails were cleared up this week but barge length continue to grow.
Fuel oil barges made good ground, gaining up to $5 a tonne, but cargoes were steady with little physical activity seen.
